description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the comparison of the correlation between ChatGPT's QA performance and ground-truth versus generated answers across three different domains. The horizontal axis contains the categories, displaying three distinct groups from left to right: Movies, Songs, and Basketball, without an explicit axis label. The vertical value axis is labeled "Correlation" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.7, with numeric tick labels placed at regular intervals of 0.1 and corresponding horizontal grid lines extending across the plot area. Within each of the three categories on the horizontal axis, bars are arranged in clusters of four. A legend in the upper right corner defines the visual encoding for these four variables: Pop_GT is represented by solid light orange bars, Pop_Ge by light orange bars with diagonal white hatching, RPop_GT by solid blue bars, and RPop_Ge by blue bars with diagonal white hatching. In the "Movies" category, the approximate values are 0.22 for Pop_GT, 0.10 for Pop_Ge, 0.36 for RPop_GT, and 0.64 for RPop_Ge. For "Songs," the correlation values are roughly 0.30 for Pop_GT, 0.09 for Pop_Ge, 0.49 for RPop_GT, and 0.70 for RPop_Ge, which marks the tallest bar in the entire chart. In the "Basketball" group, the values are notably lower, showing approximately 0.07 for Pop_GT (the shortest bar overall), 0.08 for Pop_Ge, 0.13 for RPop_GT, and 0.21 for RPop_Ge. The category clusters are not sorted alphabetically or by overall height, and the use of diagonal hatching serves to visually distinguish the generated ("_Ge") metrics from their solid ground-truth ("_GT") counterparts within each color set.
